source.title: Italy Digital Nomad / Remote Worker Visa Requirements Reference

taxonomy_fields.label: How do you work?
taxonomy_fields.description: This visa is for people who do highly qualified work remotely, using a computer or similar technology, while living in Italy.

taxonomy_fields.label: Will you be working remotely while living in Italy?
taxonomy_fields.description: This includes work performed using a computer or similar technology, from anywhere in Italy.

taxonomy_fields.label: What is your nationality?
Do you hold citizenship of an EU, EEA, or Swiss country (in addition to any other citizenship)?
Which of these best describes your qualifications?
taxonomy_fields.description: Italy's visa rules require meeting one of these 'highly qualified worker' categories.

taxonomy_fields.label: How many months of prior experience do you have in the activity you will perform remotely from Italy?
What annual income in EUR can you document from lawful work-related sources?
taxonomy_fields.description: Italy DNV screening uses the official annual income threshold from the source reference and consular guidance.

taxonomy_fields.label: Is this income from the remote work you'll be doing while in Italy?
What is this income from instead?
taxonomy_fields.description: Passive income (investments, rental income, etc.) doesn't qualify for this visa. Other active income will need manual review.

taxonomy_fields.label: Which documents can you provide as proof of work-derived income?
As a self-employed digital nomad, can you document your self-employment or freelance activity?
As a remote worker, can you provide an employment or collaboration contract, or a binding offer?
Can your employer confirm they have a clean legal record from the past 5 years?
Do you have health insurance for medical care and hospitalization valid in Italy for the stay period, or will you obtain it?
Do you have accommodation arranged in Italy for the visa period?
How many months will your passport be valid beyond your intended travel or stay period?
How many blank passport pages do you have available?
Will you be including a spouse or children on this application?
Can you provide family relationship documents for the spouse or minor children you intend to include?
What else about your Italy Digital Nomad / Remote Worker Visa situation should QIQ consider?

post_eligibility_checklist.note: These are real Italy DNV obligations sourced from requirements_reference.md, but they describe post-entry compliance steps rather than pre-visa eligibility facts. They were removed from the live eligibility-screening flow and are preserved here for a future post-eligibility checklist / output surface. Their former requirement codes still exist in clarifications.json and output.json for that purpose.

fields.label: Do you understand that self-employed digital nomads may need to request an Italian VAT number after entry?
Do you understand you must apply for a permesso di soggiorno within 8 working days of entering Italy?
Do you understand Italy will verify tax and contribution compliance, including Italian social-security rules if no bilateral agreement applies?
